intended_object: The constant map Π i, M₁ i → M₂ with value m, viewed as a continuous multilinear map when the index type ι is empty (from the docstring and name).
explanation: The definition takes the underlying multilinear map from MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty (constant map, which is multilinear because ι is empty) and proves continuity via continuous_const. This is exactly the intended object. The setting is fully general (any semiring, any topological modules, any empty ι), so it is not too narrow. It is Mathlib's own definition of this object. The closest related declaration is the non-continuous MultilinearMap.constOfIsEmpty, which it builds on.
